WITH LatestSnapshot AS (
    SELECT MAX(snapshot) AS max_snapshot
    FROM estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala
),
ChildCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        d.head_of_household_id,
        COUNT(d.id) AS child_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_demographics_impala d
    JOIN estishraf_llm_historical_population_impala h
      ON d.id = h.id
    JOIN LatestSnapshot ls
      ON h.snapshot = ls.max_snapshot
    WHERE h.is_in_population = TRUE
      AND h.age BETWEEN 0 AND 17
      AND d.head_of_household_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY d.head_of_household_id
),
WealthWithChildren AS (
    SELECT 
        w.wealth_level,
        c.child_count
    FROM estishraf_llm_wealth_index w
    JOIN ChildCounts c
      ON w.head_of_household_id = c.head_of_household_id
)
SELECT 
    wealth_level,
    AVG(child_count) AS avg_children
FROM WealthWithChildren
GROUP BY wealth_level
ORDER BY 
    CASE wealth_level
        WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1
        WHEN 'Lower Middle' THEN 2
        WHEN 'Middle' THEN 3
        WHEN 'Upper Middle' THEN 4
        WHEN 'Rich' THEN 5
    END LIMIT 20000
